purpose: Measure whether PrivMark improves stakeholder understanding of AI privacy risk compared with a technical-only report.

tasks.question: Which AI system has lower residual privacy risk?
Which privacy claim is unsupported by evidence?
Which system would you approve for a sensitive-data workflow and why?
How confident are you in your privacy decision?

note: This template is provided to support the human-centered claim in the paper. It is not executed by the benchmark runner. Use only with appropriate review and consent procedures.
